# Decision log

Append-only. An entry is never edited after the fact; a reversal is a **new** entry citing
the old one by number. Append with `/decide`. Stage one's own log is preserved at
`vendor/propsim/DECISIONS.md` and is cited as **propsim D-xx**; the Stage 2 repository's log
is cited as **stage-two D-xx**. Plain D-xx below is this file.
